params.caption: 🎮 CD Projekt's Cyberpunk 2 boss calls GTA 6 a "masterpiece" Praise for GTA 6 is coming from rival studios too. A leader working on The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 congratulated Rockstar, calling the game a masterpiece and a "generational banger." He added that what Rockstar pulled off is unbelievably hard to achieve. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 19:24 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @RockstarGames · @CDPROJEKTRED · @CyberpunkGame 🔥 React if you agree · 💬 Is GTA 6 a masterpiece so far? #GTA6 #CDProjektRed #Cyberpunk2 #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
